response.goal: Connect a few of our tools using automation.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirements gathering to identify the tools that need to be connected.
Design the automation workflow and map out the data flow between tools.
Build and test the workflow integration.
Deliver and review the final automated workflow.

milestones.deliverable: Workflow architecture plan and tool connection mapping

milestones.name: Build and Delivery
milestones.deliverable: Fully tested and operational automation workflow
